chunks: He (peace be upon him) said: Indeed, Allah, the Exalted and Glorified, is not a wrongdoer to His servants, nor unjust to His people, nor unfair to the inhabitants, nor a wrongdoer to the worlds.
ai.seo_question: What are the key attributes of Allah regarding justice towards His creation?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights this attribute to reinforce the Shia doctrine of divine justice (*Adl*), asserting that Allah’s fairness is intrinsic and absolute, extending to all creation without any injustice. This narration serves as a foundational proof for the belief that God’s actions are always wise and equitable, distinguishing Him from arbitrary power. It underscores the theological principle that no soul is burdened beyond its capacity and that ultimate recompense is perfectly measured.
